title: Anatomy of a Sink P-Trap: Maintaining the Liquid Trap Seal
description: The sink P-trap is a critical fixture drain component designed to safeguard indoor air quality. Its curved geometry intentionally retains a small pocket of water after every use, forming a continuous hydraulic barrier known as the trap seal. As new wastewater discharges from the sink basin, it displaces the existing trapped water, pushing debris into the wall arm while leaving clean water in the bend. This water plug prevents sewer odors, hazardous gases, and insects from entering the building through the drain opening. Maintaining proper slip-joint connections prevents leaks and preserves seal integrity.

Anatomy of a Sink P-Trap: Maintaining the Liquid Trap Seal

The sink P-trap is a critical fixture drain component designed to safeguard indoor air quality. Its curved geometry intentionally retains a small pocket of water after every use, forming a continuous hydraulic barrier known as the trap seal. As new wastewater discharges from the sink basin, it displaces the existing trapped water, pushing debris into the wall arm while leaving clean water in the bend. This water plug prevents sewer odors, hazardous gases, and insects from entering the building through the drain opening. Maintaining proper slip-joint connections prevents leaks and preserves seal integrity.
